VERIFIER run (ux-audit/baseline/F10/verify-01..11): pm clear, then relaunch. The same 3 explainers, 3 OS dialogs, the intro card and 7 coach marks = 14 actions. frictionNotes: 14 mandatory actions before the map is usable: 3 permission explainers, 3 OS dialogs, 1 intro card and 7 full-screen spotlight coach marks.
The OS permission dialogs appear 3-6 s after Continue, and taps during the delay do nothing.
The Bluetooth 'Nearby Devices' permission is requested up front, with alarming OS wording ('find, connect to, and determine the relative position of nearby devices').
Coach marks cover the whole screen, and there is no 'Skip tour'. Tapping or BACK advances only one card at a time.
If there is no fresh fix, the app silently falls back to Museum District and shows arrivals for the wrong area, with no 'location unavailable' message.
Coach marks come back later (for example 'Plan a trip.' after a relaunch), and there are separate first-use tips in search, stop detail and the planner.
At city zoom the map shows about 40 unlabeled 16dp stop dots and a column of route chips.

VERIFIER: confirmed. I reproduced 14 actions exactly (3 taps + 3 system dialogs + 8 overlays). BACK can dismiss overlays one by one but finds no shorter path. I also reproduced the silent Museum District fallback on this fresh install: even after an extra my-location tap the map never reached downtown, so 'usable' here means unobstructed, not correctly located.

name: Nearest stop + next bus (Route 40 northbound)
scenario: GPS 29.7563,-95.3639 (downtown, Main St @ Lamar). Goal: know which stop to catch Route 40 northbound (name + ID) nearest to me and its next arrival in minutes. Start: Explore after restart.

expertSteps.target: Route chip '40' in the left column of the Explore map (a11y label 'Nearby route 40')
expertSteps.resultingScreen: 'Choose Direction' bottom sheet: 40 NORTHBOUND to N SHEPHERD P&R / 40 SOUTHBOUND to MONROE P&R

Route 40 drawn on the map with a 'Stop: 342' callout. The stop sheet reads 'Lamar St @ Main St (342)', 40 Telephone/Heights NORTHBOUND, arrivals 7 min, 26 min, 51 min, 1:17 h... The goal information is on screen.

alternativesTried: A (shortest, reported): route chip 40, then Northbound = 2 taps, 3 screens. On first use a coach mark covers the stop sheet (+1). The first tap after launch is swallowed (+1).
B: swipe up Nearby Arrivals, then tap the Route 40 NB card = 2 actions, but the swipe is unreliable and the list never names the stop.
C: search '40', route result, SHOW ON MAP, direction = 5 actions, and it ends partial with no stop and no arrival shown.

VERIFIER D: tapping the stop-342 pin on the map (one of about 60 unlabeled dots in the blue circle) opens 'Choose Direction' (40 NB / 41 WB), then 40 NB = also 2 taps (verify-02-tap-pin342). It is not shorter, and it needs the rider to already know which dot is 342.

VERIFIER E: the Recent tab could not be reached while the stop sheet was open. Two taps on 'Recent' did nothing because the stop sheet overlays the bottom navigation (verify-07, verify-08). On a fresh session Recent is empty anyway.
VERIFIER F: the app registers a 'houstonmetrotrip:' deep-link scheme, but a rider has no way to use it, so it is not a rider path.
frictionNotes: The fastest path depends on noticing that the unlabeled number tiles are tappable 'Nearby route' chips.
The chosen stop is never shown with a distance or walk time, so 'nearest' cannot be checked on screen.
The Nearby Arrivals list never names the stop.
Arrival chips mix formats ('7 min', '1:17 h') and rely on a small legend for realtime vs scheduled.
The first tap right after launch or restart is often ignored. It happened again in verification: the first chip tap after restart did nothing (verify-03), and the second worked.
A first-use coach mark covers the arrivals row.
The bottom-sheet swipe gesture is unreliable.

VERIFIER: confirmed. Chip 40 then Northbound = 2 taps, and the screen truly shows 'Lamar St @ Main St (342)', the NORTHBOUND direction and '7 min' next arrival (verify-06-nb, and the ui dump text 'Arrives in 7m'). Tapping the stop pin is equal length, not shorter. New friction: while a stop sheet is open it covers the bottom nav, so tapping Recent/Fares/More silently does nothing.

name: Walking directions to a stop (Lamar St @ Main St, stop 342)
scenario: Same GPS 29.7563,-95.3639. Goal: walking directions (a route on the map or a turn list) from my location to stop 342, Lamar St @ Main St, about 1 block away. Start: Explore after restart.

expertSteps.target: Long-press (about 1.5 s) on the map at the stop-342 location (Lamar St @ Main St)
expertSteps.resultingScreen: Modal 'Use location "1004 Lamar St, Houston, Texas 77002, United States" as:' USE AS START / USE AS DESTINATION / Cancel
Plan Your Trip sheet (My current location to 1004 Lamar St, Leave at now). A blue destination pin appears, but no user dot or path is drawn.
DEAD END: 'Information: Cannot find any trips for this criteria' [OK]. No walking route, no path and no turn list.

missingInfo: There are no walking directions anywhere for a stop-level destination. The trip planner returns 'Cannot find any trips for this criteria' for a walk-only trip of about 1 block, whether the destination is set from a stop search, a place search or a map long-press. The stop sheet has no Walk/Directions button and no hand-off to Google Maps. The screen shows only a destination pin, with no path, distance or walking time.
alternativesTried: A (original report): search '342', USE AS 'TO' POINT, planner coach mark, Plan My Trip = 6 actions to the dead end (5 once the coach mark has been seen; 7-8 with the swallowed first tap and the OK).

B: from the F1 stop sheet, the controls are Full Schedule, Track Bus Stop and the direction row. The row's chevron only reopens 'Choose Direction' (verify-01-route-chevron). There is no Walk/Directions control. Dead end.
C: trip-planner FAB, Destination, type 'Main St and Lamar St', pick the place, Plan My Trip = 5 actions, same error.

VERIFIER D (new shortest dead end, reported above): long-press the map at the stop, then USE AS DESTINATION, then Plan My Trip = 3 actions, same 'Cannot find any trips for this criteria' error (verify-04..06). The planner coach mark did not appear because it had already been seen.
Checked the expanded planner sheet for a walk-only or mode option. There is none.
frictionNotes: There is no 'Walk here' or 'Directions' action on the stop sheet or on the stop's search result.
The trip planner treats a short walk-only trip as a failure and shows a modal error.
Routing to a stop takes a 5-option modal, and 'USE AS TO POINT' is jargon.
A first-use coach mark covers the planner form.
The error dialog gives no next step: no suggestion to walk, no distance, no 'open in Maps'.
Inside a transit itinerary, the walking leg is a straight dotted line with no street routing.

VERIFIER: the original claimed a 6-action expert path to the dead end. A shorter one exists: long-press the map, then USE AS DESTINATION, then Plan My Trip = 3 actions (4 screens), ending in the same error. achieved=no is confirmed: every entry point (search, place search, long-press, stop sheet) dead-ends, and no walking path is ever drawn. The long-press gesture is hidden (no hint anywhere), resolves to a street address (1004 Lamar St) rather than the stop, and switches on trip-planning mode, which hides the stop pins and the user dot. A first-timer would realistically take the 6-8 action search path. In the verify run, BACK from the Explore map also switched unexpectedly into the 'Plan Your Trip' sheet (verify-02-longpress-map).

name: Returning daily commuter: next Route 82 at stop 2958
scenario: GPS 29.7440,-95.3900 (Montrose). Precondition: stop 2958 / route 82 EB viewed once via search, then restart. Goal: from launch, see the next Route 82 arrival at Westheimer Rd @ Montrose Blvd (2958) as fast as possible.

expertSteps.resultingScreen: Recent list ('RECENTLY VIEWED STOPS': 82 Westheimer Rd @ Montrose Blvd (2958) 082 EASTBOUND to DOWNTOWN, ...). A 'Recent' tip sheet with a Close button covers the bottom half.
Stop detail loads underneath, but the 'Recent' tip sheet stays on top and hides the arrivals strip
Stop detail: 'Westheimer Rd @ Montrose Blvd (2958)', 82 Westheimer EASTBOUND to Congress St @ Smith St, live arrivals 7 min / 8 / 8 / 36 / 44

alternativesTried: Search by ID: tap search, type '2958', tap 'Westheimer Rd @ Montrose Blvd (Stop #2958)', 'What do you want to do?' dialog > SEE NEARBY ARRIVALS. The sheet shows '1 Nearby Arrival' 82 EASTBOUND 2m 2m 17m but does not name the stop; tap the card to reach stop detail (2958). That is 5 actions to see minutes and 6 to see them with the stop name confirmed (F2/40-46).

VERIFIER: Search-sheet Recents. Tapping the search bar shows a 'Recents' list that already contains 'Westheimer Rd @ Montrose Blvd (Stop #2958)', so no typing is needed. Path: tap search, tap the recent row, 'What do you want to do?' > SEE NEARBY ARRIVALS gives '1 Nearby Arrival' 82 EASTBOUND 8m 8m 9m. That is 3 actions, a tie with the Recent tab, but the stop name is not shown. Tapping the card to confirm 2958 makes it 4 (F2/verify-03..05).

VERIFIER: Direct map pin tap. After the map fully settled, a pixel-exact tap on the 2958 pin (located from a UI dump at the lower-left edge of a cluster of 3328/3426/3340) opened 2958 82 EASTBOUND with live minutes in 1 action (F2/verify-11). This is NOT a genuine rider path: the pins are unlabeled 42 px dots overlapping within about 20 px, and the cluster sat at a different screen position on another restart (y=1110 vs 1043). A visual tap on the same cluster gave Montrose Blvd @ Hawthorne St (3339) instead (F2/verify-10). Excluded from the expert count.

Nearby sheet from Explore: swipe the sheet up (it only half-expands, so the 82 card is cut off), tap the 82 EASTBOUND card. This opens Westheimer Rd @ Stanford St (2959), the nearest stop, not 2958, so it is the WRONG stop. 2 actions and fails (F2/22-23).

Map pin: at default zoom 2958, 3328, 3340 and 3426 sit within about 20 px of each other. Tapping gave Montrose Blvd @ Westheimer Rd (3328), route 56 SOUTHBOUND. After 2 double-tap zooms, the pins are still unlabeled and overlap a fare-retailer pin. Tapping gave the Circle K retailer popup, then 3328 again, then nothing. Abandoned after about 7 actions without reaching 2958 (F2/31-37).
Nearby route chip '82' (left column): Choose Direction > EASTBOUND opens stop 2959 (nearest), not 2958 (see F5/02-03 and F5/verify-05).
frictionNotes: VERIFIER: confirmed. Re-ran on emulator-5556: the Recent tip sheet appeared again on this visit, and it covered the 2958 stop detail's arrivals until Close was tapped. So 3 actions (2 taps + 1 overlay) is the true expert minimum. The search-sheet Recents list ties at 3 but shows no stop name. A 1-tap map pin hit is only possible with pixel coordinates from a UI dump, not visually.

The 'Recent' tip sheet ('Quickly access your recently visited stops...' + Close) appeared on EVERY visit to the Recent tab (4 of 4 times, plus the verifier's run). It is not a one-time coach mark. It also stays on top of the stop detail after you tap a row and hides the arrival times, so every daily use costs an extra Close tap.
In one run the first Close tap was ignored because the stop detail map was still loading (blank map with dots), so it needed a second tap (F2/63 vs 64).

A 'Plan a trip.' coach-mark spotlight appeared on cold launch in about 3 of 8 restarts. It swallows the first tap: tapping the Recent tab while it showed only dismissed the overlay. That adds +1 overlay action intermittently.

Recent is ordered by recency, so the commuter's stop moves position in the list. It also behaved inconsistently: stop 3337 (56 NB) was later replaced by 12092 (56 NB), which looks like one entry per route+direction. Recent rows show no arrival times, so the rider must open the stop. There are two separate 'recents' lists (the Recent tab and the search-sheet Recents) with different contents.
Stop 2958's 'Nearby Arrivals' result sheet does not show the stop name or ID, only '82 EASTBOUND TO DOWNTOWN', so the rider cannot confirm the stop without another tap.
The direction label differs between screens: 'EASTBOUND to DOWNTOWN' (Recent/nearby/pin) vs 'EASTBOUND to Congress St @ Smith St' (stop detail opened from Recent).
The bottom tab bar disappears while a stop detail is open. Android BACK from Explore exits the app with no confirmation (happened during map testing).
Accidental map taps silently open other stops and add them to Recent (3337, 12092 appeared from mis-taps while dismissing overlays; 3328 now appears after the verifier's run).
missingInfo: No favorites or pinned stop. Nothing on the home screen surfaces the commuter's stop or its next arrival. Minutes are only reachable after opening Recent and dismissing the tip (or through the search Recents, dialog and nearby sheet, which do not name the stop).

name: Route lookup: Route 82 stops and EB arrivals at Westheimer @ Montrose
scenario: From launch, find Route 82 (Westheimer), see its stops, and get real-time arrivals at the Westheimer @ Montrose stop, EASTBOUND. The measured path does not depend on location; the GPS happened to be at Montrose.

expertSteps.resultingScreen: Search sheet with keyboard
Results: '082 Route (METRO)' then 5 x 'Monroe Park & Ride (Stop #82)'
Modal 'What do you want to do?': SHOW ON MAP / SEE FULL SCHEDULE / Cancel
Route 82 Westheimer page: PDF Schedule link + 6 buttons (Weekday/Saturday/Sunday x EASTBOUND/WESTBOUND with terminal names)

expertSteps.target: 'Weekday: EASTBOUND (Richmond Ave @ Westheimer Rd - Congress St @ Smith St)'
expertSteps.resultingScreen: '82 Westheimer EASTBOUND / Weekday' stop-by-stop timetable starting at Richmond Ave @ Westheimer Rd (7886) 3:50 am

expertSteps.target: One fast fling up on the timetable (about 80 ms)
expertSteps.resultingScreen: Timetable flings to the END of the list. The top row is 'Westheimer Rd @ Montrose Blvd (2958) 4:43 4:53', followed by 2959 ... Congress St @ Smith St (9204)

expertSteps.target: Row 'Westheimer Rd @ Montrose Blvd (2958)' (not marked clickable)
expertSteps.resultingScreen: Modal 'What do you want to do?': HIGHLIGHT / SEE NEARBY ARRIVALS / SHOW ON MAP / USE AS 'TO' / USE AS 'FROM'
Explore sheet '1 Nearby Arrival': 82 EASTBOUND TO DOWNTOWN with live minutes (stop name not shown)
Stop detail 'Westheimer Rd @ Montrose Blvd (2958)', 82 EASTBOUND to DOWNTOWN, live 1 min / 2 min ...

alternativesTried: Original claimed path with 4 timetable flings (12 actions). The verifier reproduced it with 1 fast fling (9 actions), twice from a fresh timetable (F5/verify-13/14 and verify-20).

VERIFIER: Stop dialog 'SHOW ON MAP' instead of SEE NEARBY ARRIVALS: it only recenters the Explore map with the 82 line; no stop detail and no arrivals open ('4 Nearby Arrivals' collapsed). Not shorter (F5/verify-16).

VERIFIER: Nearby chip '82' > Choose Direction > EASTBOUND opens 2959 with the route 82 line and white stop dots drawn. Tapping the dot for 2958 on the line did nothing, and the 2958 marker disappeared from the accessibility tree while 2959 was selected. The first chip tap after launch was swallowed again (F5/verify-03..06).
VERIFIER: Stop-detail route row chevron ('82 Westheimer EASTBOUND to DOWNTOWN >') on 2958: tapping it did nothing, so there is no route page and no stop list from a stop (F5/verify-01).

SHOW ON MAP path: search, type '82', tap 082, SHOW ON MAP, then a second modal 'Please choose direction', pick 82 EASTBOUND. The map jumps to an arbitrary Uptown/Galleria segment (Winsome/Chimney Rock) with small unlabeled white stop dots and no stop list (re-confirmed F5/verify-08). The earlier attempt failed after 7 actions (F5/30-31).
Searching the stop directly by name/ID skips 'find route 82 and see its stops', so it does not meet this goal (see F2 search-by-ID: 6 actions).
frictionNotes: VERIFIER: shorter path found, 9 actions instead of 12. A single fast fling on the stop-by-stop timetable scrolls to the end of the list, and 2958 happens to be the 19th-from-last EB stop, so it lands as the top row (reproduced twice). This is luck of position. A mid-route stop would still need several scrolls with no search or jump, and the fling skips past about 70 stops, so the rider does not really 'see' the stop list. The expert count only holds for stops near the end of the route. A first-timer with normal swipes still needs about 8 scrolls (J4 measured about 3 min).
The stop list only exists inside 'Full Schedule' as a timetable. It starts at 3:50 am and does not scroll to now. There is no search or filter.
Timetable rows are tappable but not marked clickable and have no chevron, so nothing hints that tapping a stop leads to arrivals.
Two modal dialogs ('What do you want to do?' for the route, then again for the stop) plus an intermediate nearby sheet that hides the stop name. The rider passes 8 distinct screens.
The route result reads '082 Route (METRO)' with a zero-padded number and no 'Westheimer' name. Five 'Monroe Park & Ride (Stop #82)' results compete with it.
The direction buttons use terminal stop names (Richmond Ave @ Westheimer Rd - Congress St @ Smith St) rather than plain 'toward Downtown'.

SHOW ON MAP centers on an arbitrary route segment far from the rider and gives no way to list stops or pick one reliably. Pins at intersections overlap across routes, and route-line stop dots are not tappable while another stop is selected.
missingInfo: There is no route page with an ordered stop list and live arrivals per stop. You cannot search within a route's stops, the timetable does not jump to the current time, and the stop-detail route row does not lead to the route.

name: Service alerts for Route 82
scenario: Find out whether a current service alert/detour affects Route 82 and read it. If none exists, read an alert for another route.

expertSteps.resultingScreen: More menu: Route Schedules, Service Alerts, Fare Card Retailers, Learn How to Ride, ...
LEAVES THE APP: Chrome opens ridemetro.org/alerts/service-alerts-and-detours with a yellow Red Line banner, a hero image and 'Current Alerts' intro text

expertSteps.target: One firm scroll of the page (about 1000 px with momentum)
expertSteps.resultingScreen: Scrolls past the route selector to the first alert card, which is fully readable: '5 Southmore / Route 005 Southmore detoured at Scott @ Griggs due to construction. Posted: Tuesday, July 14, 2026 ... Affected stops: Scott St @ Griggs Rd - Stop #9977 (eastbound) ...'
'Route / Select a route' dropdown visible above the Route 5 Detour card
Native picker listing ONLY routes with alerts: 5, 6, 11, 20, 23, 25, 26, 28, 29, 40, 41, 44 ...
Picker shows 73, 75, 77, 86, 99 ... 700 METRORAIL RED LINE. 82 is absent between 77 and 86, so the rider must INFER there is no Route 82 alert

alternativesTried: Original claimed path (8 actions): More > Service Alerts > scroll to dropdown > open picker > scroll picker (no 82) > scroll picker back up > pick '25 Richmond' > scroll to alert body. Valid but not minimal, because the unfiltered page already shows a complete alert (Route 5) right under the dropdown. There is no need to scroll the picker back and filter to another route.

VERIFIER: 5-action variant. With a gentler first scroll that stops at the dropdown (original's step 3 position), the Route 5 alert headline 'Route 005 Southmore detoured at Scott @ Griggs due to construction.' is already on screen under the dropdown (F6/verify-04). Then open the picker and scroll it (82 missing). That is 5 actions if a headline counts as 'reading' an alert. It needs +1 swipe to read the affected-stops body, which is why 6 is reported.

First-timer run: More > Service Alerts triggered Chrome first-run 'Welcome to Chrome' (tap 'Use without an account') and 'Chrome notifications' (tap 'No thanks'), 2 system dialogs, then a cookie consent banner ('No, thank you'), 1 overlay, before the page was usable (F6/02-04). That adds 3 actions.

Scrolling the unfiltered alerts page instead of the dropdown: 36 'Detour' cards (routes 5, 6, 11, 20, 23/26, 25 x2, 26 x3, 28 ...), each with long raw turn-by-turn text. Confirming 'no 82 alert' this way needs reading the whole page (about 15+ swipes).

In-app: showing Route 25 on the map (search '25', 025, SHOW ON MAP, EASTBOUND) shows no alert icon, banner or FAB (F6/20-22). The Route 82 map and stop 2958 detail show no alert status either. The More menu has no other alert entry (Route Schedules, Service Alerts, Fare Card Retailers, Learn How to Ride, RideMETRO.org ...).
frictionNotes: VERIFIER: shorter path found, 6 actions instead of 8 (5 if the Route 5 headline counts as reading the alert). The original scrolled the picker back up and filtered to Route 25 just to read an alert, but the first alert card (Route 5 Southmore) is already readable on the unfiltered page directly under the dropdown. The achieved=partial rating holds: 'no Route 82 alert' is only inferable from 82's absence in the picker, never stated.

The scroll position is very sensitive. One firm swipe overshoots the dropdown into the first alert (verify-03), and a gentle one stops at it (verify-04). The page's sticky header then reappears on scroll-up and covers the upper area, which makes it easy for an elderly user to lose the selector.
Service alerts are not in the app at all. The More menu hands off to Chrome, and on a fresh phone that means browser sign-in and notification dialogs plus a cookie banner.
A 'no alerts for my route' answer is never stated. The dropdown silently lists only routes with alerts, so the rider must scroll it and notice 82 is missing between 77 and 86.
The site's sticky social-media footer (Facebook/X/YouTube/Instagram/LinkedIn) covers about 7% of the screen bottom, and a stray tap opens other apps, which is a real risk for elderly users.
The yellow site-wide banner (Red Line interruption) is the most prominent alert even for a Westheimer rider, and it takes about a quarter to a third of the screen.
Alert text is raw dispatcher shorthand ('Via Grigg Rd (L) Scott St (L) Scottcrest St (R) into Southeast TC', '**Eastbound**') with no map and no end date.
The app's stop detail and route views show no alert indicator, so a rider at stop 2958 would never be prompted to check.
missingInfo: No in-app alert list. No per-route or per-stop alert status and no explicit 'No alerts for Route 82' message. Detours have no map or plain-language summary of affected stops. Checking alerts requires an external browser.

name: Plan a trip and know exactly where to board
scenario: Rider at University of Houston (GPS 29.7199,-95.3422) plans a trip from current location to William P. Hobby Airport, picks the first itinerary, and must learn the boarding stop name plus stop ID or direction, and the bus headsign. Measured on RideMETRO v2.71, emulator-5558. First itinerary: walk 5 min to 'M L King Blvd @ Uh University Dr', Route 80, transfer to Route 73, then a 17-min walk.

expertSteps.target: Trip-planning FAB (icon-only, content-desc 'Turn Trip Planning Mode On')
expertSteps.resultingScreen: Plan Your Trip sheet (From: My current location / To: Choose destination / Leave at now / Plan My Trip disabled)
Full-screen destination search with keyboard
Autocomplete list (Hobby Airport, William P. Hobby Airport (HOU), Hobby Airport Departure, ...; all with the same pin icon)
Plan Your Trip sheet with destination filled
Select Itinerary list (5 options; first is Walk 5m > 80 16m > Walk 1m > 73 18m > Walk 17m, '1:6min')
My Itinerary: 'Walk to M L King Blvd @ Uh University Dr', route badge 80, 'Transfer to the M L King Blvd @ Bellfort on 080 bus'. No stop ID, direction, side of street or headsign.

expertSteps.target: Drag itinerary sheet down (the only one-gesture exit; discards the planned trip)
expertSteps.resultingScreen: Explore map left at the zoomed-out trip framing; nearby circle at Golfcrest, '2 Nearby Arrivals'
Explore centered on UH, '6 Nearby Arrivals', route chips 25 / 80 / 900
Choose Direction sheet: 80 SOUTHBOUND to MLK & PARK VILLAGE / 80 NORTHBOUND to TIDWELL TC

expertSteps.target: 'SOUTHBOUND to MLK & PARK VILLAGE' (rider must infer SB from the itinerary map line)
expertSteps.resultingScreen: Stop detail: 'M L King Blvd @ Uh University Dr (11424)', 80 MLK / Lockwood, 'SOUTHBOUND to MLK & PARK VILLAGE', map callout 'Stop: 11424', live 5/7/25 min. GOAL MET.

alternativesTried: Measured first-timer path (13 actions): steps 1-6, tap the boarding-stop row (only zooms the map to an unlabeled white circle, no ID; 07), then 3 BACK presses to unwind My Itinerary > Select Itinerary > Plan Your Trip > Explore (09-11), swipe the Nearby sheet up (12), tap the '80 SOUTHBOUND TO MLK & PARK VILLAGE' card (13), and dismiss the 'View when the next bus or train will arrive' coach mark (14)
Exit via 3 BACKs instead of the swipe: 3 actions vs 1, but it may keep the map at UH. Exiting with the swipe needs a my-location FAB tap afterwards, so both reach 'Explore at UH' in 2-3 actions
From Explore at UH: swipe the Nearby sheet up + tap the 80 SB card (2 actions) is the same cost as route chip 80 + Choose Direction (2 actions)
Tapping the itinerary's stop row, the route badge or the map boarding circle: none opens the stop. They only pan/zoom the map (07, 08)

Explore search by stop name was not measured in full here. Per the J2 audit it returns two identical 'M L King Blvd @ Uh University Dr' results (#11424/#11425) plus a 'What do you want to do?' modal, so it is longer than the chip path
Destination Recents: on a second plan the destination search lists 'William P. Hobby Airport (HOU)' under Recents, so a tap replaces typing (same action count, no keyboard)

Run A (runA-stale-location/): before a live GPS fix reached the app, 'My current location' silently resolved to a stale downtown point. The planner routed from Milam St @ Dallas St on route 500 with no warning. Only tapping the my-location FAB fixed it

VERIFIER: Explore search > 'hobby airport' > 'William P Hobby Airport, 7800 Airport Blvd' > 'What do you want to do?' modal > USE AS 'TO' POINT > Plan My Trip. That is 5 actions to the itinerary list, the same as the FAB path, plus a 'Search' coach mark that covers the planner (+1 overlay, so 6 total). Not shorter (verify-14, verify-15, verify-16)

VERIFIER: long-pressing the boarding row only zooms the map, like a tap. Tapping the 'Every 20 min' frequency chip does nothing. Tapping the green Google transit POI next to the boarding circle does nothing (verify-07, verify-08, verify-09)

VERIFIER: tapping stop pin 11424 on Explore (content-desc 'Ho414_4620_11424') opens Choose Direction listing '25 WESTBOUND to WESTCHASE' and '80 SOUTHBOUND to MLK & PARK VILLAGE'. That is 2 taps to stop detail, the same cost as the route chip. It needs the map at UH zoom, so it is not shorter (verify-13)

name: Transit center departure bay
scenario: GPS 29.7890,-95.4560 (given as Northwest Transit Center; it is actually about 500 m north of the TC bays, on N Post Oak Rd). Goal: find which bay Route 58 departs from (outbound, not arrivals) and its next departure time.

expertSteps.target: Launch after restart with a live GPS fix. With a working fix the app centers on GPS at launch, even when the last camera was elsewhere (checked in verify-07/08). Without a fix it stays at the old camera and the my-location FAB is needed.
expertSteps.resultingScreen: Explore map, '8 Nearby Arrivals', chips 58/66/85/89

expertSteps.resultingScreen: Explore map, '15 Nearby Arrivals', chips 39,47,49,58,66,70,72,84,216,217,298

expertSteps.target: '58' Nearby route chip (4th chip in the left column after the pan)
expertSteps.resultingScreen: Stop sheet 'Northwest Transit Center - Bay M (79)', 58 Hammerly WESTBOUND to WEST BELT, now / 1:00 h / 2:00 h

alternativesTried: GPS Nearby list: dismiss 'Plan a trip.' coach mark (overlay), tap my-location, swipe sheet up, tap '58 WESTBOUND TO WEST BELT'. This opened street stop 'N Post Oak Rd @ Post Oak Green Ln (8249)' with 21 min and no bay. Dead end for the bay goal: 4 actions + 1 overlay (F7/01-05).

VERIFIER: tapping the 58 chip at the raw GPS position with no pan opens 'Choose Direction' (WESTBOUND to WEST BELT / EASTBOUND to NORTHWEST TC). Picking WESTBOUND opens street stop 8249, not the TC. That is 2 actions and fails the goal (verify-09, verify-10).

Search: tap search, type 'Northwest Transit', tap 'NW TC - Platform 1 (Stop #13170)', 'What do you want to do?' dialog, SEE NEARBY ARRIVALS. The list first shows STALE arrivals and only refreshes after you swipe the sheet down. Then tap the 58 chip to get Bay M (79). About 6 actions (F7/10-17, 21-27).
Tapping the TC map pin (from the prior audit, REPORT J1.5): about 8 actions. It lists only routes ending at the TC (arrivals), not departures.
Search results list 'NW TC - Platform 1 - Bay C/D/E/G/H/I...' all as '(Stop #13170)' with no routes per bay.
frictionNotes: The 2-action expert path relies on hidden knowledge. The TC has no label or icon on the map, the left chips are unlabeled route numbers, and a chip silently opens one direction at whichever stop the app picks. At the raw GPS position the same 58 chip opens Choose Direction and then street stop 8249 instead of the TC.
The bay letter only appears on the final stop sheet title ('Bay M (79)'). No list shows bays or departures grouped by bay.
The stop code is inconsistent: search says Platform 1 = Stop #13170, but the 58 departure sheet says Bay M (79).
The 'See nearby arrivals' list stayed stale until the sheet was dragged.
Without a GPS fix the app opens at the previously viewed location and the my-location FAB must be tapped. The FAB gives no error when there is no fix.
Tapping the sheet drag handle does nothing. The sheet only expands with a swipe.
Arrival times use '1:00 h' / '1:21m' formats, which are ambiguous for hours versus minutes.

VERIFIER: confirmed. I reproduced swipe + chip-58 on emulator-5560 and got 'Northwest Transit Center - Bay M (79)', 58 WESTBOUND to WEST BELT, next departure 'now'. After launch I found no 1-action path. On this emulator the emulator geo fix alone did not reach the app. I had to stream test-provider locations (cmd location providers set-test-provider-location for gps, fused and network) before the app would center on GPS. With a live fix the app centers on GPS at launch even from a stale camera, so step 0 is valid as a 0-action start.
missingInfo: No departures-by-bay view, no bay diagram, no TC label on the map, and no way to filter out routes that end at the TC. The bay is only discoverable at the last step.
